relations.subject: α grain size
relations.evidence: An average value of α grain size is derived from each distribution and can be used as the d parameter to calculate the yield strength via the Hall-Petch relationship in the form: σy = σ0 + kyd−1/2 In this work, two sets of empirical constants σ0, ky are used for com­ parison to the measured yield strengths, one derived from a study on PBF-LB material [37] and one from PBF-EB [38] via linear regression, with values: σy PBF−LB = 743 + 242d−1/2, σy PBF−EB = 737 + 144d−1/2 The two equations are displayed as lines in Fig. 14b, where d−1/2 is plotted against the calculated yield strength.
